rationale.quote: NVDAx (xStocks NVIDIA) is the quote asset: an AI-compute equity for an AI-private-markets operator. PreStocks cannot be DBC quotes (1% Token-2022 transfer fee); NVDAx carries a Meteora token badge and no fee.
rationale.curve: Single-segment curve that sells 80% of supply before graduation and migrates the remaining 20% with the raised NVDAx, so price discovery happens in stock terms and the post-migration pool opens near the final curve price.
rationale.fee: Flat 1% fee collected in the quote token, so the operator treasury accrues NVDA exposure rather than its own token. 50% of trading fees go to the creator (agent treasury), 50% to the partner.
rationale.graduation: Graduates at 10 NVDAx raised into a DAMM v2 pool with a fixed 1% fee; liquidity is permanently locked (no rug path).
rationale.authority: Immutable token metadata and mint authority: the operator cannot mint more tokens after launch.

disclaimer: The agent token is a market for the autonomous operator and its community. It is not equity, a fund share, a security, or a claim on the PORT portfolio or its fees. PORT is hackathon software; nothing here is investment advice.
